channel.title: Wire — Security
channel.description: Security from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Update on a security incident involving 1Password’s backend systems
item.description: 1Password identified a security incident involving some of our backend systems. Customer vaults were not accessed and remain secure. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: UK government forced to admit it issued Apple a secret encryption order
item.description: The Investigatory Powers Tribunal has rejected the UK government’s attempt to keep its order secret, marking a significant victory for transparency. (1 source: hackernews)
